english.title: Occupier / manager of smoke-free place open to the public fail to display sign - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who occupied or was concerned in the management of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), which were smoke-free by virtue of section 8 of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017 (premises that are open to the public), failed to ensure that at least one sign was displayed which contained a legible graphic representation of a burning cigarette enclosed in a circle with a bar across the circle which crosses the cigarette symbol
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 13 of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020 and section 17(1), (5) and (8) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.

english.notes:
(i) For defences to this offence, see section 17(6) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.
(ii) The fixed penalty amount is £200 (regulation 20(a) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020); the discounted amount £150 (regulation 21(a)). For the form of the fixed penalty notice, see regulation 22.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a person who occupied or was concerned in the management of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), which were smoke-free by virtue of section 8 of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017 (premises that are open to the public), failed to ensure that at least one sign was displayed which contained a legible graphic representation of a burning cigarette enclosed in a circle with a bar across the circle which crosses the cigarette symbol.
